product.name: Enable Agentic Operations
product.version: Prototype spec 0.19 with current local implementation
product.stage_basis: 用户要求评审 prototype；本地 Vite Demo 可交互但不连接真实 LLM、邮箱、SharePoint、调度或发送服务
primary_users: Operations specialist who delegates and reviews operational outcomes
Process owner who creates and governs repeatable Flows
Operations lead or auditor who monitors execution and evidence

candidate_core_tasks.goal: Delegate and complete a governed monthly report
candidate_core_tasks.decision: Resolve conflicting authorized data and approve the final external-delivery package
candidate_core_tasks.success_outcome: The intended report is delivered or clearly completed, with artifacts, decisions, approval, and audit evidence retained

candidate_core_tasks.goal: Turn repeatable operational work into governed automation
candidate_core_tasks.decision: Confirm Flow definition and Schedule settings before publishing or activation
candidate_core_tasks.success_outcome: A published Flow and its Schedule are visible as durable managed objects and can create future work

candidate_core_tasks.goal: Monitor an execution that needs attention and safely recover or stop it
candidate_core_tasks.decision: Choose upload, continue search, retry, resume, rerun, or cancel based on current evidence
candidate_core_tasks.success_outcome: The execution continues, ends, or is cancelled with its status and audit history accurately preserved

authorization_boundaries: 只读导航与可逆的本地 Demo 交互
不提交对外发送、权限变更或真实生产操作
本地 Reset demo 可用于恢复 fixture
